items.quote: It exports scenes to `.3mf`, `.dae`, `.glb`, `.gltf`, `.obj`, and `.stl` formats using `Scene.save()`
items.truth: Scene.save() cannot produce .dae (exporter lookup hits FbxExporter's unimplemented supports_format and raises NotImplementedError) and cannot produce a usable .obj: a filename save opens the file 'wb' and ObjExporter writes a str (TypeError), and even a text-stream save writes nothing because _collect_nodes stops at the entity-less root node.

items.quote: Cap2["Export to common 3D formats"] --> Output["3MF, COLLADA, GLB, glTF, OBJ, or STL file"]
items.truth: Neither COLLADA (.dae) nor OBJ can be written through Scene.save() at this revision (NotImplementedError for .dae; TypeError for a .obj filename, empty output for a stream).

items.quote: Aspose.3D FOSS for Python reads and writes OBJ, STL, glTF, and COLLADA files
items.truth: COLLADA and OBJ cannot be written via Scene.save() (the README's own bullet below admits COLLADA export is unreachable); 3MF, which does round-trip, is omitted.

items.quote: The package `aspose-3d-foss` could not be confirmed on PyPI (package registry: a distribution of this name exists, but ownership not confirmed: the registry's project URLs point at another repository).
items.truth: aspose-3d-foss 26.1.0 is published on PyPI (requires_python >=3.7) and is the official package; this sentence is internal analysis text, wrongly withholds `pip install aspose-3d-foss`, and contradicts the Development section's 'Install the published package from PyPI (`aspose-3d-foss`, version 26.1.0)'.

items.quote: Install the published package from PyPI (`aspose-3d-foss`, version 26.1.0):
items.truth: The colon introduces no install command (the next block is a git-clone editable install), and installation from PyPI belongs in the Installation section, which currently says the opposite.

items.quote: with automatic format detection from the file extension or an explicit `FileFormat` argument
items.truth: Scene.open(file, options) always detects the format from the extension for filenames (or detectors for streams); a non-LoadOptions second argument such as a FileFormat is discarded and replaced by detected_format.create_load_options().

items.quote: `Scene.open()`/`Scene.save()` cannot detect or dispatch any of these extensions, and raise a `RuntimeError` if you try
items.truth: Scene.open() raises RuntimeError for these extensions, but Scene.save() raises AttributeError ('NoneType' object has no attribute 'create_save_options') because get_format_by_extension returns None.
items.review_quote: and raise a `RuntimeError` if you try

items.quote: utilities for scene construction, entity management, and rendering
items.truth: Rendering is not implemented: Scene.render raises NotImplementedError and Renderer/RenderFactory/Viewport raise on construction (the README's own Scope section says the library does not render).

items.quote: Triangulate arbitrary polygon data into triangle fans
items.truth: PolygonModifier triangulates by ear clipping and only falls back to a fan when no ear is found; the next clause of the same bullet says it is not a naive fan split.

items.quote: - Author and edit mesh data directly through `Mesh.control_points`, `Mesh.create_polygon()`, and
items.truth: These two loose bullets repeat the 'Create and edit mesh geometry' capability already listed above and sit outside the bolded capability list.

items.quote: python3 -c "from aspose.threed import Scene; print('Aspose.3D FOSS OK')"
items.truth: A second 'Verify the install' step sits at the end of Quick Start after the examples; install verification already appears in Installation.

items.quote: More real, verified snippets are collected below
items.truth: 'real, verified' is review/pipeline wording, not user-facing documentation.

items.quote: The verified public surface has 337 types.
items.truth: 'verified public surface' is analysis wording; the table does list 337 rows (332 + 5 enumerations).

items.quote: reproduced directly against this build
items.truth: Investigation/evidence wording that should not appear in a public README (the underlying claim is correct: FbxExporter precedes ColladaExporter in IOService and its base supports_format raises).

items.quote: the entire `aspose.threed.render` module (`Renderer`, `RenderFactory`, `Viewport`, and related classes) raise `NotImplementedError`
items.truth: Renderer, RenderFactory and Viewport do raise, but 18 of the 60 render modules (e.g. BlendFactor, CompareFunction, PixelFormat enum holders and the exception classes) contain no NotImplementedError at all.

items.quote: Material class lets you manage texture maps and custom properties, supporting specular, diffuse, emissive, ambient, and normal maps.
items.truth: Material.get_texture and Material.set_texture both raise NotImplementedError, and Texture/TextureBase cannot be constructed, so no texture maps can be managed.

items.quote: WeightedMode enum values NONE, OUT_WEIGHT, NEXT_IN_WEIGHT, and BOTH let developers specify how vertex weights are applied during mesh processing.
items.truth: WeightedMode is the keyframe tangent-weight mode used by KeyFrame.tangent_weight_mode in the animation module; it has nothing to do with vertex weights or mesh processing.

items.quote: exposes translation, scale, euler_angles, rotation, and transform_matrix properties for direct manipulation
items.truth: All five GlobalTransform properties are read-only getters (no setters); the world transform cannot be manipulated through it.

items.quote: Records one bone's world and local transform matrices inside a `Pose`
items.truth: BonePose holds a single `matrix` plus an `is_local` flag, not separate world and local matrices.

items.quote: ImageRenderOptions lets you configure rendering parameters such as background_color, enable_shadows, and asset_directories before passing the options to a renderer.
items.truth: No renderer exists to pass the options to: Scene.render and Renderer raise NotImplementedError.

items.quote: optional `Mesh`-derived entities, and materials
items.truth: Node entities are Entity subclasses (Camera, Light, Curve, Mesh...), not Mesh-derived.

items.quote: The test suite, located in the tests/ directory, uses the standard-library unittest framework
items.truth: Only 24 of the 34 files in tests/ use unittest; others such as test_fbx_simple.py, test_imports.py, test_mesh.py and test_polygon_modifier.py are plain scripts/pytest-style functions, and `unittest discover tests/` reports 5 errors from missing examples/ fixture files.

items.quote: The PyPI packaging readiness document confirms that Aspose.3D FOSS for Python meets the requirements for distribution on PyPI.
items.truth: docs/PYPI_READINESS.md is a stale checklist about a package named `aspose-3d` with an examples/ directory that does not exist at this revision.

items.quote: This is raised in Scene.Open/Scene.Save when no licenses are applied.
items.truth: Nothing in the package raises TrialException; there is no licensing in this FOSS build (the class is only defined and exported). Appears in both API tables.
